Publish.LongDescription:
# Intro
First Person Camera Continued allows you to explore your city from the perspective of a cim either with a free camera near ground level or by following any cim/vehicle.
This mod is a continuation of the First Person Camera mod by optimus-code (H3llb0und) with new features.
# How To Use
To enter free camera first person mode, click on the video camera icon near the upper right hand corner and click "Enter Free Camera" from the dropdown or press Alt+F on your keyboard.
To move around use WASD, use SHIFT to walk faster and R/F keys to increase/decrease the camera height.
To enter follow mode, right click on an object in free camera first person mode or click on the video camera button in the info panel for the object. Alternatively, open the "Follow Random" submenu in the dropdown that appears after clicking the main mod button and choose Citizen, Vehicle, or Transit to follow a random one of that type in your city, or Custom to open a window where you can mix and match exactly which vehicle or creature type(s) to include.
To shift the camera forwards or backwards in follow mode press the UP ARROW and DOWN ARROW keys, to change the height use the R/F keys.
To toggle a picture-in-picture window press P. This shows an overhead camera view of your current location. Scroll to zoom in/out or use CTRL + scroll to resize the window.
To exit follow mode press WASD, to exit first person mode, press ESC or ALT+F.
# Settings
Several loaded parameters can also be configured from the main game settings, taking effect at the start of each first person session, including:
In General Tab:
- FOV - Walking Speed - Running Speed - Citizen Height - Transition Speed Factor
In UI Tab:
- Game UI Visibility - Info Box Visibility - Info Box Size - Display Units - Stop Strip Visibility
In Picture-in-Picture Tab:
- Show PIP On Enter - PIP Snap To Corner - PIP Aspect Ratio - PIP Size - Show PIP Marker - Show PIP Underground View
# Localization
Currently Supported Languages:
- English - Chinese (Simplified) - Chinese (Traditional) - French - German - Japanese - Korean - Polish - Portuguese (European) - Portuguese (Brazilian) - Russian - Spanish
Help translate this mod via Crowdin: https://crowdin.com/project/cs2-first-person-camera-continued
# Strip Map Station Names
When following a transit vehicle, station names displayed on the strip map are determined using the following priority:
For metro/train stations: - Custom station name (set by clicking station and renaming) - Street name where the stop is located, with cross street shown if multiple stops share the same street name
For bus/tram stops: - Custom stop name (set by clicking stop and renaming) - Vanilla assigned stop name by street address
# Notes
- Enter first person free camera mode in the editor by using the keyboard shortcut - Unsubscribe from the First Person Camera Temporary Reupload by Nyoko, or the original First Person Camera mod by H3llb0und to prevent compatibility issues
# Conclusion
If you like this mod be sure to leave an upvote! Thanks

# v1.7 Main New Features: - Added custom follow random mode window where you can granularly select what to follow - Added altitude information in infobox for aircraft
Improvements:
- Improved strip map stop name detection and filtering - Improved follow camera for wildlife - Improved backend random follow querying and vehicle type detection - Improved dropdown menu with submenus and optional quick open keybindings - Improved UI tab setting ordering
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed bottom clamping issue after following citizens - Fixed PIP not closing when exiting first person mode while "Show Game UI" turned on - Fixed issue where FOV increased with fast transition speed - Fixed issue where background city sounds became quieter each session - Fixed speed info box width padding not rendering when following after free camera entry - Fixed missing vanilla UI sounds - Fixed svg scaling issue
